roots.fix: Loopback-only binds with the Host check always on; escape scouted records; same-origin guard on every state-changing endpoint.

roots.fix: Import os, run stage commands on a worker thread, bound every TeX run with a timeout.

roots.title: Untrusted values reach argv where they can act as options
roots.fix: End options with -- (or reject a leading -) before every value-bearing positional, quote remote command text once, and make dry-run the default the guard assumes.

roots.title: Managed revision names can escape their sidecar directory

roots.title: The engine's crash recorder writes defects for invalid input, outside the gated targets
roots.fix: Classify unreadable input as a refusal, and record a crash only through resolve_target/validate_name into an existing product dir.
